title: Capture Cursor agent-transcript schema from a real Mac
description:
Capture and pin the agent-CLI transcript format from a real Mac: JSONL transcripts at ~/.cursor/projects/<sanitized-path>/agent-transcripts/<session-id>/<session-id>.jsonl (the project path with slashes replaced by dashes), with per-session metadata in ~/.cursor/chats/<workspace-hash>/<session-id>/store.db. The line-level schema (type, role, text, timestamp fields) is not publicly documented — pin it from real files before writing extraction. Also check whether older plain-text .txt transcripts coexist. Record findings; never commit real transcripts.

Done when: the line schema is documented from real files, synthetic fixtures encode it, and findings record the evidence.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Captured and pinned the Cursor agent-CLI transcript schema from the real ~/.cursor on this Mac (487 JSONL files, 35405 lines; structural fields only, no text recorded anywhere).

**Line schema (main transcripts at ~/.cursor/projects/<sanitized>/agent-transcripts/<sid>/<sid>.jsonl):**
- Message lines carry only {role: user|assistant, message: {content: [...]}} — no top-level type, NO timestamps, NO message ids anywhere in the file. 2932 user lines, 31456 assistant lines.
- User content is always exactly one block: {type: "text", text: string} (2932/2932). Assistant blocks: {type: text|tool_use}.
- turn_ended control lines: {type: "turn_ended", status, error?} (1017).
- Genuinely typed input is ALWAYS fully wrapped: <user_query>...</user_query> (165/165 wrapped, none empty, no partial wrappers). Injected context rides as tagged user-role lines: <timestamp> (1922), <dynamic_tools>, <dynamic_tool_catalog>, <available_subagent_types>, <manually_attached_skills>, <open_subagent_context>, <cursor_commands>. Untagged user lines exist (4, in one project) and are now treated as typed.
- Subagent transcripts: <sid>/subagents/<uuid>.jsonl (plain uuid names, not agent- prefixed); their user lines are injected (787/801 <timestamp>). Discovery already skips them — unchanged.
- No legacy .txt transcripts inside agent-transcripts dirs (0). The 678 .txt files live under <project>/agent-tools/<uuid>.txt and are tool outputs, not transcripts.

**store.db does not exist.** Per-session metadata is ~/.cursor/chats/<workspace-hash>/<sid>/meta.json: {schemaVersion: 2, createdAtMs, updatedAtMs, hasConversation, cwd} (only present for some sessions). prompt_history.json may coexist.

**Timestamps:** since lines carry no time, the adapter now resolves a session-level timestamp: meta.json updatedAtMs (else createdAtMs) when the session id is registered under ~/.cursor/chats, else the transcript file mtime (end-of-session approximation). This is a documented granularity limitation: window filtering is session-granular for cursor-agent; the <timestamp> injected tags parse cleanly but are not reliably adjacent to the typed lines (0-6+ lines away), so per-message attribution is not sound.

**IDE state.vscdb (global + 19 workspace dbs, all scanned):** zero bubbleId:* rows and zero composer:* conversation rows anywhere; composer.composerData = {hasMigratedComposerData, hasMigratedMultipleComposers, lastFocusedComposerIds, selectedComposerIds} (no allComposers list); no composer.composerHeaders:<id> rows (only tableGateEnabled/version flags); composer.planMigrationToHomeDirCompleted = 1. Conversations have migrated out of state.vscdb to ~/.cursor — the cursor-ide source yields nothing on current versions (tolerant path retained).

Fixtures: real-shape lines (user_query wrap, <timestamp>/<dynamic_tools>/<available_subagent_types> injected, turn_ended, subagents dir) plus chats meta.json added to tests/fixtures/sentiment/cursor-home; 3 new gold labels. The meter now extracts real cursor-agent data: 169 human messages / 65 sessions over all time on this Mac. 132 sentiment tests green.
